I'll go with Version B. Version A just refuses and leaves me with nothing, which would frustrate me — sites are down for a minute all the time, and if I've got a link in hand I want to get it into my library right then, while I'm thinking of it, not lose it because the page happened to hiccup. Version B lets me save the address with my own title and a note, tells me honestly that there's no saved copy yet, and — the part I really like — says it'll keep trying on its own to grab the details and a copy later. So I don't have to babysit it or remember to come back and redo it.

The one thing I'd want to be sure of, since it matters to me: that bookmark shouldn't just sit half-finished forever and silently give up. As long as it keeps retrying and fills in the page details and the saved copy once the site's reachable again — and I can still tidy the title myself in the meantime — Version B is the outcome I want.
